description: Patch release: adds Hub workflows and knowledge search, refreshes Chinese-first project guidance, and moves Pi Agent skills to the shared `.agents/skills/` root.
changelog:
**Features:**
- feat(hub): add `suncode hub review`, review artifact submission, latest-review inspection, review gating for completion, and Hub task review status synchronization.
- feat(hub): add Hub skill package and agent package push/pull commands for synchronizing local `.agents/skills` and `.suncode/agents` packages through Hub.
- feat(hub): add compact Hub knowledge-base search with project-scoped results for agent-facing workflows.
- feat(init): refresh default generated specs with Chinese-first writing guidance and Git workflow guardrails.

**Fixes:**
- fix(hub): tune Hub knowledge search defaults and compact output for lower-context agent consumption.
- fix(pi): install Suncode skills once under the shared `.agents/skills/` root instead of duplicating them under `.pi/skills/`.

**Internal:**
- test: extend Hub review, package sync, knowledge search, initialization template coverage, and Pi shared-skill migration safety.

migrations.description: Pi Agent: move installed Suncode skills from the private `.pi/skills/` root to the shared `.agents/skills/` root.
migrations.reason: Pi discovers `.agents/skills/` natively. Keeping a second `.pi/skills/` copy makes Pi see duplicate Suncode skills when Codex, Gemini CLI, or another Agent Skills consumer is also configured.

notes:
Run `suncode update --migrate` after upgrading if Pi Agent was already configured; this retires the legacy `.pi/skills/` copy while preserving canonical shared templates and user-modified content through the normal migration safeguards.

A fresh init needs no migration. The update also delivers refreshed Hub review skills, Hub synchronization commands, knowledge search support, and generated spec guidance.

Install: `npm install -g @wjptz/suncode`
